economic_question: Can a lifecycle-clear recurring release of currently open exposure cap multiple independent equity drawdown episodes while preserving enough of the accelerator's later original profit to beat the qualified anchor inside 20% native equity DD?

new_mechanism.name: lifecycle-clear recurring open-exposure equity ratchet
new_mechanism.trigger_state: candidate-local stressed sampled-equity drawdown from the current episode high-watermark
new_mechanism.action: realize the released fraction of aggregate marked floating P/L, retain the declared fraction of each currently open lifecycle and subtract $25
new_mechanism.cooldown: disable another action through the last affected original close while every later original birth still enters at full exposure
new_mechanism.rearm: on the first sampled snapshot strictly after cooldown, reset the local stressed-equity high-watermark and permit a later independent action
new_mechanism.flat_trigger_behavior: wait for later open exposure while the local DD condition remains binding

counterfactual.release_economics: per episode, realize the released fraction of aggregate marked floating P/L and subtract $25
counterfactual.affected_future_close: retain only the declared fraction of each affected lifecycle's frozen actual/stressed close economics
counterfactual.doubled_cost: preserve the full observed cost drag across released and retained fractions
counterfactual.transition_equity_envelope: through each affected bundle's last original close, apply the settled prior shift plus min(-$25, episode final candidate-minus-baseline delta); afterward settle the exact episode delta
counterfactual.identity_check: the sum of all episode deltas must exactly reconcile modified closed-path economics to the untouched accelerator
counterfactual.interpretation: a conservative fixed-path recurring-state proxy, not candidate-specific MT5 proof

selection_gates.profit: after embedded per-episode $25 reserves and an additional $75 uncertainty reserve, actual and doubled-cost-stressed net must each strictly exceed qualified observed +$1,691.54 / +$1,626.26
selection_gates.epochs: all four modified actual and stressed epoch nets must be positive
selection_gates.capital: actual/stressed closed balances and sampled equity envelopes must remain positive
selection_gates.drawdown: max(qualified native 19.550371765% + 0.25 points, worse conservative sampled equity DD + 0.193561860 points + 0.50 points) <= 20%
